facts.business: H.G. Infra Engineering Limited is an infrastructure construction company engaged in engineering, procurement and construction of roads, rail networks, energy assets and other infrastructure projects across India.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding uncertainty related to outcome of search proceedings conducted by the Central Bureau of Investigation, Anti-Corruption Bureau, Patna. The Company has appointed an external firm to review certain aspects. The Company's position is that there is no impact on the standalone financial statements at this stage.

key_risks: Uncertainty related to outcome of CBI search proceedings
Estimation of contract cost and revenue recognition under Ind AS 115
Project execution delays and cost overruns
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions include remuneration to Managing Director Mr. Harendra Singh and Whole-time Director Mr. Vijendra Singh Choudhary (brothers), and transactions with subsidiaries/associate companies for fund/non-fund based facilities and bank guarantees.
